patient_overview.name: Dominic Rivera
patient_overview.description: A 22-year-old Puerto Rican male college student recovering from a gunshot wound trauma. He is a community volunteer and feels protective over his younger siblings. He has a history of Type 2 Diabetes (prediabetic history) but is now poorly controlled. He is skeptical of healthcare systems and authority figures, showing resistance to standard medical advice. He has limited health literacy and low motivation to adhere to strict dietary or medication regimens. patient_overview.name: Yvette Armstrong
patient_overview.description: A 64-year-old Eastern European American woman recently diagnosed with Stage II hypertension and uncontrolled type 2 diabetes. Works full-time as a state employee with an associate's degree in political science. Curious and earnest but feels overwhelmed by complex medical information.
